description: Recorded run setup and summarized results; historical paths identify original artifacts.

record.status: Terminal and audited; fixed-rate candidate discarded from adoption, preserved for review.
record.policy: Per-worker token bucket for send submissions; 100k/s, burst 4; administrative output bypasses pacing. Deferred payloads stay owned until submission or cancellation.
record.retention_rule: Require a measurable benefit against retained zhtps, including timeout counts, while reporting every latency, throughput, CPU and memory tradeoff; ties remain open. No diagnostic instrumentation or changed client deadline in decision trials.
record.decision: Lower offered read-timeout counts are preserved, but the initial effect size did not hold in longer windows; saturated failures tied, longer p99 tied, and CPU/RSS/p50 costs persisted.

record.status: All ties, unfavorable metrics, and overlapping comparisons remain open.
record.scope: 18 GET runs: retained tcp-retries-v1, isolated send-pacing-v1, Go; three rotated trials per load.
record.queue_caveat: Host-wide counters cover whole runs, including setup, warmup, all offered phases, and cleanup. They are not per-request or phase attribution. ECN marks and drops are kept distinct.
record.trial_range_caveat: Three observed trial ranges are not formal confidence intervals.
